infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Photographs of the work you carry out are attached to the job sheet as evidence of what was done.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your position is recorded when you arrive, start, finish and photograph a job, to prove attendance. It is not recorded continuously and never outside working hours.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Not used. Photographs are taken in the app and are never read from or written to your camera roll.
